question: Tell me about a time you had to adapt to a significant change at work.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates ability to thrive in dynamic environments.
exampleAnswer: When our company restructured the engineering org, my team was split and I was reassigned to a new project with a different tech stack. Situation: I had two weeks to get up to speed. I created a learning plan, paired with a senior engineer, and delivered a small feature in the first week to build confidence. Result: I became a productive team member within three weeks and later helped onboard two more new joiners.
evaluationCriteria: Proactive adaptation, structured approach, measurable outcome
followUpQuestions: How do you help others adapt to change?
What is the biggest change you've faced?
How do you stay positive during uncertainty?
